title: Localized range maps to the scalar extension range
statement: For a commutative ring R, modules X,Y, a linear map f, and a prime ideal p, there exists an A-linear equivalence from the localization of Y to the scalar extension of Y whose map sends the localized range of f to the range of the scalar-extended map, where A=Localization.AtPrime p.

proof.text: Put A = Localization.AtPrime p and let A0 be A restricted along algebraMap R A. The identity on A gives an R-linear equivalence A to A0, with scalar compatibility Algebra.smul_def. Compose LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct with TensorProduct.congr of this identity and the identity on Y, and extend linearity from R to A using LinearEquiv.extendScalarsOfIsLocalization. The resulting equivalence e sends y/1 to 1 tensor y.

By Submodule.localized'_eq_span and Submodule.map_span, the image under e of the localized range is the A-span of the elements 1 tensor f(x). Each generator is the image of 1 tensor x under the scalar-extended map. Conversely, induction on tensor products shows that every image is in this span: zero and sums preserve membership, and a tensor x maps to a tensor f(x), which is a times the generator 1 tensor f(x). Return the constructed equivalence and this range equality.

lean.statement:
theorem localized_range_quotient_extendScalars_aux
    (R : Type v) [CommRing R] (X Y : ModuleCat.{v} R) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (𝔭 : Ideal R) [𝔭.IsPrime] :
    ∃ e : LocalizedModule 𝔭.primeCompl (Y : Type v) ≃ₗ[Localization.AtPrime 𝔭]
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))).obj Y : Type v),
      ((LinearMap.range f.hom).localized 𝔭.primeCompl).map e.toLinearMap =
        LinearMap.range ((ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))).map f).hom
